name: BOSU Ball Push-Up
steps: Place a BOSU ball dome-side down on the floor, grip the outer edges of its flat platform firmly, and step back into a high plank.
Brace your abs and glutes tightly to keep the platform level beneath your shoulders.
Bend your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle from your ribs to lower your chest smoothly toward the platform.
Press evenly through both hands to straighten your arms back to the starting plank.
tips: Keep the platform level from side to side and your hips aligned with your shoulders.
Widen your feet slightly if you need extra balance on the unstable surface.
